race.comment: PURE MOTIVE (3) brings in winning trial form. The market will tell all from a strong stable around here. You have to give her a big hope if the barrier is not a hurdle on debut. ALL TOO MYSTERIOUS (2) is a first-starter by All Too Hard who was an AUD $ 26,000 (Inglis 2024 Ready2Race Sale) purchase. Well-educated with three trials. Worth consideration. SIMPLY SONNET (9) encouraging effort last time when third over 1006m at Grafton. Ready to peak. SUNS OUT GIRLS OUT (10) daughter of Sebring Sun from Girls Go Racing on debut. Ran second at recent trial. Monitor any market confidence. HOT CHESTNUT (6) will be up the front for some way, but the record suggests he has a lot to do now. Could add some value to wider plays.
